subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Micro-Fulfillment Centers
description: A quick win: understand Micro-Fulfillment Centers.

hook.text: A 5,000 square-foot robot warehouse sits inside a grocery store's back room. It fills orders in 3 minutes.

buildup.text: Micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs) are small, automated facilities placed inside or near retail stores.

discovery.text: Robots store and retrieve items in dense grids, handling high-velocity SKUs with incredible speed.

twist.text: MFCs handle only 8,000–15,000 SKUs. The rest must still be picked manually from store shelves.

climax.text: Kroger and Walmart are testing MFCs to make online grocery profitable—a problem nobody has fully solved.

punchline.text: Small footprint. Big speed. Automation meets the neighborhood.
